claims: Artemis II is NASA's first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
Artemis II is slated as a 10-day test flight around the lunar far side and back to Earth.
Artemis II will launch four astronauts named Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen will be launched aboard the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen will be launched aboard the Orion spacecraft.
Artemis II will test critical life-support systems
